mentions.name: createmascot.art
mentions.description: A web tool that lets software teams create a consistent brand mascot and generate illustrations of it for product use cases like empty states, onboarding, 404 pages, and launch graphics. It addresses the difficulty of keeping the same AI-generated character consistent across dozens of product illustrations.
mentions.problem: AI can make a good one-off character, but keeping that same character consistent across dozens of product illustrations is still surprisingly difficult.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://createmascot.art/ a tool for software teams to create a consistent brand mascot and generate illustrations of it for empty states, onboarding, 404 pages, launch graphics, etc.
